# Checkpoint

Issue: JPG files are missing from QtWebEngine file pickers when image MIME types are accepted.

Plan: inspect `webview.py` and existing tests, implement a runtime Qt version gated suffix workaround using Python `mimetypes`, integrate it into `chooseFiles`, then run relevant local tests.

Status: implemented the runtime Qt 6.2.3–6.6.x gate, MIME and wildcard suffix resolution, and `chooseFiles` integration. Added unit coverage for version boundaries and suffix handling. `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen pytest -q tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py` passed (12 tests); `git diff --check` passed. No delegation used.

 from qutebrowser.config import config
-from qutebrowser.utils import log, debug, usertypes
+from qutebrowser.utils import log, debug, usertypes, qtutils
 
 
 _QB_FILESELECTION_MODES = {
@@ -32,6 +33,30 @@ _QB_FILESELECTION_MODES = {
 }
 
 
+def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes: Iterable[str]) -> Set[str]:
+    """Return missing suffixes for Qt's MIME-filtered file picker.
+
+    Work around missing MIME type extensions in Qt 6.2.3 through 6.6.x.
+    """
+    if (not qtutils.version_check("6.2.3", compiled=False) or
+            qtutils.version_check("6.7.0", compiled=False)):
+        return set()
+
+    accepted_types = set(upstream_mimetypes)
+    suffixes = set()
+    for mime in accepted_types:
+        if mime.endswith("/*"):
+            prefix = mime[:-1]
+            suffixes.update(
+                suffix for suffix, mapped_mime in mimetypes.types_map.items()
+                if mapped_mime.startswith(prefix)
+            )
+        elif "/" in mime:
+            suffixes.update(mimetypes.guess_all_extensions(mime))
+
+    return suffixes - accepted_types
+
+
 class WebEngineView(QWebEngineView):
 
     """Custom QWebEngineView subclass with qutebrowser-specific features."""
@@ -265,6 +290,10 @@ class WebEnginePage(QWebEnginePage):
         accepted_mimetypes: Iterable[str],
     ) -> List[str]:
         """Override chooseFiles to (optionally) invoke custom file uploader."""
+        accepted_mimetypes = list(accepted_mimetypes)
+        accepted_mimetypes.extend(sorted(
+            extra_suffixes_workaround(accepted_mimetypes)
+        ))
         handler = config.val.fileselect.handler
         if handler == "default":
             return super().chooseFiles(mode, old_files, accepted_mimetypes)

--- a/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py

@@ -9,6 +9,7 @@ import pytest
 webview = pytest.importorskip('qutebrowser.browser.webengine.webview')
 
 from qutebrowser.qt.webenginecore import QWebEnginePage
+from qutebrowser.utils import qtutils
 
 from helpers import testutils
 
@@ -58,3 +59,51 @@ def test_enum_mappings(enum_type, naming, mapping):
     for name, val in members:
         mapped = mapping[val]
         assert camel_to_snake(naming, name) == mapped.name
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("qt_version, expected", [
+    ("6.2.2", set()),
+    ("6.2.3", {".jpg", ".jpe"}),
+    ("6.6.9", {".jpg", ".jpe"}),
+    ("6.7.0", set()),
+])
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_version(monkeypatch, qt_version, expected):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtutils, "qVersion", lambda: qt_version)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        webview.mimetypes, "guess_all_extensions",
+        lambda mime: [".jpg", ".jpe"] if mime == "image/jpeg" else [],
+    )
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(["image/jpeg"]) == expected
+
+
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_mime_and_suffixes(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtutils, "qVersion", lambda: "6.5.2")
+    mappings = {
+        "image/jpeg": [".jpg", ".jpe"],
+        "video/mp4": [".m4v", ".mpg4"],
+    }
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        webview.mimetypes, "guess_all_extensions",
+        lambda mime: mappings.get(mime, []),
+    )
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/jpeg", "video/mp4", ".jpg"]
+    ) == {".jpe", ".m4v", ".mpg4"}
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(["image/jpeg", ".jpg", ".jpe"]) == set()
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround([".jpg"]) == set()
+
+
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_wildcard(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtutils, "qVersion", lambda: "6.5.2")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.mimetypes, "types_map", {
+        ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+        ".jpe": "image/jpeg",
+        ".png": "image/png",
+        ".mp4": "video/mp4",
+    })
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/*", ".jpg"]
+    ) == {".jpe", ".png"}
